title: Set Cech nerve and coordinate-deletion face maps
statement: Let $f:A\to B$ be any map of sets. For every integer $n\geq0$ define the degree-$n$ set Cech nerve by $C_n(f)=\{x:\{0,\ldots,n\}\to A\mid f(x_i)=f(x_0)\text{ for all }i\}$. For $0\leq j\leq n+1$, define $d_j:C_{n+1}(f)\to C_n(f)$ by deleting coordinate $j$: $d_j(x)_i=x_i$ if $i<j$, and $d_j(x)_i=x_{i+1}$ if $i\geq j$. No surjectivity or nonemptiness is assumed; in degree zero the condition is vacuous.
